user.title: Add a Pley server
user.description: Enter the address you open Pley at in a browser. You'll sign in with a code next.

data_description.url: For example {ip_example}, {host_example} or {https_example}. Without a port, http goes to Pley's own, 7539. Plain http is only for the local network.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Pley server found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the Pley server {name} at {url}? You'll sign in with a code next.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The Pley server {name} at {url} no longer accepts Home Assistant's sign-in. Sign in again with a code, as the same profile.

reconfigure.title: Change the server's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the address the Pley server {name} has now. It must be the same server: it proves it is before Home Assistant uses the new address.

link_failed.title: Sign-in didn't finish
link_failed.description: Submit to get a new code and try again.

progress.wait_for_sign_in:
On a phone or computer, open [{url}]({link}) and enter this code:

**{code}**

Sign in to Pley there if it asks, then allow Pley for Home Assistant. This continues once you have.

error.denied: The sign-in was refused on Pley's link page.
error.expired: The code expired before anyone allowed it.
error.invalid_url: That isn't a server's address. Enter a host name or an IP address, with a port if it isn't 7539.
error.issuer_mismatch: The server answers as a different address. If it is behind a reverse proxy, make the proxy pass the original Host header on.
error.not_pley: Something other than a Pley server answers at this address.
error.too_many_sign_ins: Too many sign-ins with a code are waiting on the server. Try again in a few minutes.
error.too_old: This Pley server is too old for Home Assistant. Update Pley, then try again.
error.unencrypted: Plain http is only for the local network. Use an https address for a server elsewhere.
error.wrong_server: A different Pley server, or another device, answers at this address.

abort.not_pley: This isn't a Pley server Home Assistant can add.
abort.wrong_profile: You signed in as {username}, a different Pley profile than this entry's. To use another profile, delete the entry and add Pley again.
abort.wrong_server: A different Pley server answers at this address than the one this entry is for.

init.title: Devices shown by default
init.description: Pley adds a media player for each device that plays or is ready to. Devices of the kinds chosen here start enabled; the others start disabled. This applies to devices Pley first sees from now on: enable or disable one seen before on its device page.

data_description.shown_kinds: Devices of the other kinds still get a media player, disabled until you enable it on the device's page.

server_too_old.title: The Pley server {name} needs updating
server_too_old.description:
The Pley server {name} at {url} is older than this version of Pley for Home Assistant needs, so its devices aren't shown and can't be controlled.

Update Pley on the server. Home Assistant tries the server again every so often, and this goes away once it connects.

wrong_server.title: The Pley server {name} isn't at its address
wrong_server.description:
Something answers at {url} that can't prove it is the Pley server {name}: another Pley server, or another device. Home Assistant sends it nothing, so the server's devices aren't shown.

If the server has a new address, change it: in **Settings** → **Devices & services** → **Pley**, choose **Reconfigure** from the server's menu. If the server was reinstalled with a fresh data folder, it is a new server: delete this entry and add Pley again.

This goes away once the server answers at its address again.

auth_failed.message: The Pley server no longer accepts Home Assistant's sign-in.

cannot_connect.message: Can't reach the Pley server at {url}.

wrong_server.message: A different Pley server, or another device, answers at {url}, so Home Assistant sends it no token.

issuer_mismatch.message: The Pley server at {url} answers as a different address. If it is behind a reverse proxy, make the proxy pass the original Host header on.

too_old.message: The Pley server at {url} is too old for this version of Pley for Home Assistant. Update Pley on the server.

update_failed.message: Can't fetch what plays from the Pley server: {error}

not_playing.message: Nothing is playing on this device now.

not_controllable.message: This device doesn't take that command from a remote.

too_many_commands.message: Too many commands went to this device at once. Try again in a moment.

session_gone.message: What was playing has stopped, or the device has gone.

forbidden.message: The Pley server doesn't let Home Assistant do that: {error}

command_failed.message: The Pley server refused the command: {error}

invalid_media_id.message: {media_id} isn't something Pley plays. Use pley://item/ID, pley://playlist/ID or pley://channel/ID, with the ID from the web app's address for it.

invalid_extra.message: The extra option {key} has a value Pley doesn't take.

enqueue_unsupported.message: Pley plays what it's sent at once, in place of what's playing: it can't add to a queue.

not_receiver.message: This device isn't ready to play what it's sent. Open Pley on it first.

not_castable.message: This device's Pley app doesn't play that when it's sent it.

cast_not_found.message: The device has gone, or this Pley profile can't see that title, playlist or channel.

cast_failed.message: The Pley server refused to play it: {error}

invalid_browse_id.message: {media_id} isn't a folder or a title Pley's media browser opens.

browse_not_found.message: That library, title, playlist or list of channels is gone, or this Pley profile can't see it.

browse_failed.message: Can't fetch it from the Pley server: {error}
